title: Itongo ryazimiye mw'ijoro rimwe
intro: Iyumvire ubusitani buteye igomwe, burengewe n’ivyamwa bihimba kandi bukikujwe n’ibiti biteye igomwe. Abayibungabunga biyumvira ko ari abanyabwenge, bagategura umwimbu wabo mu masaha y’agacerere imbere y’uko umuseke ugira, kure y’amaso y’abakeneye. Ariko Uwo atigera asinzira yari afise iyindi migambi y’ubutunzi bwabo bwihishije. Woba ushobora gukeka uwuhagaze inyuma y’iyi nkuru y’imburi iva muri Korowani?
clues: Twari twari dufise itongo ryiza cane kandi ryuzuye cane ku buryo abahita bose baciye bavyipfuza.
Mu gutegura kwacu, twaratongana mu gitondo cane, tukamenyesha ko ata mutima w’umukene uzokwemererwa kwinjira uwo musi.
Twari abantu b’ubutunzi, kandi imitima yacu yari yacitse impumyi ku burenganzira bw’abakene bari badukikije.
Igihe umuseke w’umwimbu twari duteguye washika, twaregereye itongo ryacu gusa maze dusanga ryahindutse igihome c’umwirabura mw’ijoro rimwe.
Itegeko ry’agahomerabunwa ryarateye, nta kindi ryasigaye atari ivu aho amarundo y’ivyamwa vyivye yari yaramanitse.
Inkuru yacu ni imburi ikomeye yanditswe muri Korowani, aho tuzwi ko ari ba nyen’itongo twima abakene ubugiraneza.
